title: On the Schematic and Analytic Constructions of the Local Langlands Category
summary: We prove a folklore conjecture identifying two categorical enhancements of the automorphic side of the local Langlands correspondence. Concretely, we construct an equivalence for torsion coefficients between the category considered by Zhu and the one considered by Fargues-Scholze. To achieve this, we revisit Scholze's analytification functor and apply the first author's theory of kimberlites. We discuss unconditional applications to the splitting of the semi-orthogonal decomposition on BunG, and the compatibility with Eisenstein functors.
